explanation: Verdict concerns migration from the fully patched 18.7 baseline to stock 18.10, not a claim that upstream newly introduced all these defects: all three owned families require REBASE/RETAIN, none is behaviorally equivalent enough to retire, and the partial target replay is not a candidate; findings below identify five concrete lost protections, with 0035 and 0066 distinguished inside the compaction finding. Orchestration review: manual selection uses the active host model for remote/image eligibility (target session-maintenance.ts:1192-1225), summary candidates resolve configured target then host/roles/largest window (3410-3456), manual and automatic summary requests converge on core compact(), auto threshold/overflow/idle/incomplete share runAutoCompaction (4363 onward), and target-specific threshold/headroom changes must survive rebasing rather than be overwritten; whole/split-turn and native signed-summary preservation have explicit consumers, successful native compression skips local summarization, core native catches rethrow on aborted signals and preserve NativeCompactionError, while advancing to the next user-configured method is an intentional host policy rather than an unconditional catch-to-summary bug; cancellation is checked before manual/auto commit (1496-1509, 5330-5350), commit marks the operation before append and rebuilds messages/provider state before emitting hooks (2420-2491), so a hook failure after commit must not be reported as an uncommitted cancellation or trigger duplicate compaction. Static inspection establishes request construction, budget arithmetic, image removal and dispatch behavior only—not server cache residency, billing accuracy, actual cache hits, or durable disk completion under process crash; in particular Anthropic native requests intentionally omit context_management (pi-ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts:5412-5420) and introduce the signed-compaction beta (2528-2533), so those namespace/protocol differences must be reported separately from client prefix drift, the patched baseline deliberately lets the provider decide live-chain capacity and only replans on a classified overflow (core compaction.ts:1032-1150), historical usage is not a fresh cache attestation, the 90-minute pruning idle threshold is not proof that keepalive-maintained server cache is cold, no new standalone upstream regression or additional current-baseline defect was established in this slice, no execution/provider requests/filesystem edits occurred, and all three required policy grep checks matched.

findings.title: Rebase the host-vouched summary and native live-context capabilities
findings.body: MIGRATION-COMPACTION-001; family-compaction / 0035 and 0066: REBASE, not retire. Stock 18.10 generateSummary serializes only the summary range at pi-agent-core/src/compaction/compaction.ts:890-905 instead of accepting the exact host-produced system/tools/message prefix; its Anthropic native branch still builds a prefix cut at safeCut at 1980-1989. Pristine 18.7 has those same limitations, whereas replay-18.7 compaction.ts:1044-1076 selects the full host-vouched Anthropic chain and 2547-2592 does so for native compaction. Therefore installing target without rebasing loses 0035's structured prefix path and 0066's full live native request: the summary request no longer has the live message prefix, and the native breakpoint returns to a historical cut rather than the actively refreshed tail. This is a locally provable request-shape regression, not proof of a particular server miss rate. Upstream already has buildProviderContext and transformed native tools; rejecting it merely as 'raw tools' would be a false positive. Restore the callback and its manual/auto/advisor callers, candidate-object/session/leaf ownership checks, prior-summary carrier check, full-chain instructions, split-turn single-call suppression, and named overflow-to-cold transition while preserving upstream safeCut/retained-file handling. Acceptance should capture actual consumer-generated live/summary/native requests using synthetic contexts, including one split turn, and distinguish same-host-model whole-chain selection from different-summary-model cold selection; a classified overflow must fall back without replaying the whole chain repeatedly. Actual cache success still requires provider usage and compatible beta/context-management namespaces, which this offline audit cannot establish.

findings.title: Retain the zero-suffix warm-prefix supersede guard
findings.body: MIGRATION-SUPERSEDE-001; 0046-supersede-warm-prefix-guard: RETAIN/REBASE alongside upstream lookback support. Target session-maintenance.ts:757 restores undefined for non-prefix-bound models, which pruneSupersededToolResults interprets as its 8,000-token default; replay-18.7 instead passes zero for every model. A successful reread with a small intervening tail consequently permits mutation of the older sent read result during a warm session. Target's new cacheLookbackFloor (pruning.ts:212-273) limits the number of blocks to the preceding reusable prefix; it does not prevent a rewrite or prove the cost of the surviving checkpoint, and providers without a lookback setting bypass that additional guard entirely. This recreates the capability 0046 removed, rather than being a new upstream bug relative to pristine18.7. Keep suffixTokenLimit: 0 at the host call and retain upstream cacheLookbackPositions/convertToLlm arguments. One useful consumer probe is a non-prefix-bound model with two same-file successful reads and a nonempty suffix: the older result must remain unchanged before idle expiry and become eligible after the configured idle interval. Do not assert that elapsed conversation time proves server cache expiry when separate keepalive requests can refresh it.

findings.title: Credit the archive replaced by repeated snapcompact passes
findings.body: MIGRATION-SNAPCOMPACT-001; family-image-budget-snapcompact / previous-archive credit: REBASE. Target #projectPreSnapcompactContextTokens counts only the three preparation message regions and omits the previous summary and its frames. prepareCompaction excludes compaction markers from those regions (compaction.ts:1420-1427; messages.ts:297-318), while snapcompact.compact explicitly carries previous archive source text forward (snapcompact.ts:2155-2173), and #projectSnapcompactContextTokens counts the complete new summary and frames. Thus on a second pass the reduction guard compares the complete replacement archive against only newly eligible history plus the retained tail, and can reject a genuinely reducing replacement, leading to another configured summary method or failed manual compaction. This exists in pristine18.7 and stock18.10 but is repaired in replay18.7 by #projectPreviousArchiveTokens. Restore that credit using historyBlocks with the same byte cap and active tokenizer; keep target's new 50% archive/60% post-compaction sizing and retry-fit distinctions. A discriminating parent probe should drive the actual manual compaction consumer with a retained archive whose replacement shrinks the total but exceeds the new-history-only budget, and a control whose replacement genuinely inflates it; only the former should pass the reduction check.

findings.title: Preserve API-aware image budgets at every outgoing consumer
findings.body: MIGRATION-IMAGE-BUDGET-001; family-image-budget-snapcompact / provider namespace: REBASE. Stock target returns unknown provider IDs to five images because providerImageBudget still takes provider alone (snapcompact.ts:559-565), and the actual outgoing clamp at this location drops oldest images beyond that count. SDK dispatch invokes it after inline imaging and before provider normalization at sdk.ts:4198-4207 and also on the side-request path at 5172-5177, so a configured gateway using an otherwise recognized API loses older archive/attachment images when a sixth image is added. Replay18.7 instead resolves explicit provider, then API, then Command Code alias namespace; pristine18.7 shares the target limitation. Restore both helper signatures/declarations and all consumers: outgoing count clamp, both inline-imaging budget sites, and normal/rescue frame caps in maintenance. Preserve upstream's separate post-decoration byte clamp, unreadable-image handling, and assistant-output exclusion rather than replacing the new implementation wholesale. Acceptance should exercise the SDK's actual image-transform consumer with a custom provider on anthropic-messages and a Command Code alias, verifying retained-image order and that explicit API limits outrank the alias heuristic; unknown unrelated IDs must retain the five-image floor. Server acceptance of every gateway's numeric limit is not proven by the namespace lookup.

findings.title: Retain measured frame pricing in the active tokenizer domain
findings.body: MIGRATION-FRAME-PRICE-001; family-image-budget-snapcompact / measured DeepSeek frame pricing: REBASE. Target frameTokens removes replay18.7's measuredSteps path and returns only the generic image-tokenization rule, so the exact measured DeepSeek IDs served by the Command Code custom API revert to that API's generic formula rather than the retained step table. This propagates beyond a display estimate: Tokenizer stores frameBilling/frameBillingKey (tokenizer.ts:182-185) and uses frameTokens for retained compaction-summary image blocks (335-357), which feeds manual/auto reduction checks and target's new per-frame rerender arithmetic (session-maintenance.ts:3738-3748, 3792-3800). The checked-in baseline explicitly distinguishes these routes from Claude on the same API; removing the override changes pass/fail decisions and frame retention for identical archives. Restore FrameBilling.measuredSteps, its declaration, lookup table, price-key identity and frameTokens precedence as one capability, without broadening exact model IDs into a DeepSeek prefix match or changing the upstream conservative frame-cap policy as an incidental fix. Local source can prove that retained frames and rerender calculations use the restored table, but cannot revalidate historical provider billing measurements; integrate that assertion into the repeated-compaction consumer probe rather than adding a separate formula-echo test.
